name: Vit nuoc man
summary: Vịt nước mặn Vàm Sát is a brackish-water duck Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty. People there say it is raised along the beach, feeds with the tide, and eats seafood, so the meat is firm, sweet, and low in fat. The cook the story calls best is nướng rơm, grilled in straw, with a pepper and lemongrass dip.
origin: Can Gio, at Vàm Sát. Dân Việt, 28 Apr 2024.
howToEat: The story says there are several cooks and that straw-grilling is the best. The duck goes yellow. The meat is soft, fresh, and naturally sweet.
